messages:
deploy-bot: Canary roll for release v2.15.0 -> eu-west-1 finished stage 1 at 2024-05-02T09:46:39Z. Starting post-deploy verifications: synth probes (embeds/completions), kv prefill, liveness and readiness checks.

maria: synth probes show embed p95 uneven across hosts, one host intermittently spiking ~300ms above baseline. no errors yet.

ops-bot: [SYNTH] eu-west-1 embed-route p95 = 1.68s (baseline 1.35s) | error-rate 0.0% | jitter on host-11 flagged.

owen: can you share the probe sample? wondering if tokenization batch or cpu contention.

kevin: tailing the agent logs for host-11: 
```
2024-05-02T09:47:02Z INFO prefill: schedule accepted id=pf-992
2024-05-02T09:47:04Z WARN prefill: backlog growth detected (sched_delay=420ms)
2024-05-02T09:47:07Z INFO kvcache: fill started prefixes=200/200
2024-05-02T09:47:12Z ERROR io: temporary read timeout from disk, retrying
```

viv: that IO timeout explains the transient p95 bump. Looks localized to host-11 storage. Should we do a micro-rollback for that host only (traffic-exclude) or try a retry prefill?

maria: prefer traffic-exclude for that host and a prefill retry. we can keep canary moving otherwise. exclude command: `deploy-bot traffic-exclude eu-west-1 host-11`

ops-bot: Hold applied: canary progression paused for host-11 exclusion in region eu-west-1.

owen: running prefill retry on host-11 (job pf-retry-993). If IO clears it should stabilize. If not, ops to reprovision host.

kevin: note: autoscaler also kicked a scale-down in the last 10m and there may be IO pressure during ephemeral disk cleanup. we should check scale events.

maria: grabbing scale events now. also tagging this as a post-deploy observation in release tracker.

ops-bot: [INFO] rollout-note appended -> rt-2024-05-02-1719609999: host-11 io timeout during prefill; excluded and retrying.

viv: suggested acceptance criteria to resume: - embed p95 <= 1.4s for 10m window - no embed errors - KV miss rate <2% across hosts

maria: agreed. if criteria met we'll remove exclusion and let traffic split continue 20% -> 50% -> 100%.

owen: prefill retry running; logs show re-attempt succeeded on prefixes 0..150, stalled briefly on final chunk, now completed.

kevin: rechecking synth: p95 back to 1.33s across region. error-rate 0.0%, KV miss 0.8%.

viv: great. maria can you lift exclusion and instruct deploy-bot to resume canary ticks for eu-west?

maria: lifting exclusion now: `deploy-bot traffic-include eu-west-1 host-11` and resuming canary progression with conservative step.

deploy-bot: Exclusion removed. Resuming canary rollout in eu-west-1: traffic step to 40% for embeddings. Next automated verification in 10m.

ops-bot: [CHECKPOINT] saved -> rollout-tracker#rt-2024-05-02-1719609999.

viv: I'll keep monitoring the synth dashboard but this looks like a localized infra flake. filing a follow-up with infra to inspect disk perf on host-11.

maria: adding note to release notes: "eu-west-1 canary observed transient IO timeout on host-11 during KV prefill; excluded and retried prefill; metrics stabilized; rollout resumed."

kevin: ack. If anything regresses we open a rollback discussion. For now, marking as resolved-monitoring. :white_check_mark:
